# Gold Sponsor - Svar Life Science 

**At Svar Life Science, we are complementing life science.**

We transform how life science, pharma, healthcare, and academic partners advance their **complement related testing, analysis, and assessment needs.** With a unique combination of expertise, high quality products, specialized services, and proprietary technology platforms, Svar delivers **end to end, customizable solutions that no single provider can match**.

Our portfolio supports a wide range of **clinical and translational research applications**, including functional biomarker analysis, mechanism of action studies, immunogenicity evaluations, complement activity profiling, and programs that connect preclinical discoveries to clinical outcomes. These offerings help teams generate decision critical data, assess drug safety and efficacy, understand immune related toxicities, and meet regulatory expectations with confidence.

For customers across the life sciences, pharma industry, and academia, we provide a **flexible and seamless experience** across diverse development needs. Our high quality assay products, strong laboratory services, and proprietary technology platforms form an integrated offering that supports innovation from early research through late stage development.

**At Svar, we are dedicated to our customers' journey.**

We bring deep understanding and long standing experience in **complement system activation, immunogenicity, and broader immunological mechanisms**. This specialist knowledge powers our advanced **cell engineering, assay development, and contract research services**—enabling reliable, high quality outputs that accelerate both preclinical and clinical stage programs.

Our team helps customers address complex scientific challenges, safely and efficiently moving candidates through development phases and toward the patient, even when standard solutions fall short. Whether supporting exploratory biomarker strategies, validating pharmacodynamic endpoints, or delivering clinical grade assay panels, we ensure robust, fit for purpose data at every stage.

Svar Life Science is built on proud Scandinavian roots, strong values, and a global perspective. "Svar" means "answers" in Swedish—and you can be sure of ours. For more than **30 years**, we have worked across the clinical diagnostic value chain, turning complex questions into actionable answers.␍

**Explore our solutions at: [www.svarlifescience.com](www.svarlifescience.com)**

# Silver Sponsors

## QuidelOrtho

[![](../images/quidel-ortho-indigo-white-logo.png){fig-align="center" width=50%}](https://www.quidelortho.com/)

**QuidelOrtho Specialty Products Group (SPG)** is a well-established name in immune system monitoring, assays for the assessment of complement activation and biosafety and cytotoxicity testing. 
QuidelOrtho SPG's MicroVue product portfolio includes ELISAs, multiplex, antibodies, proteins, depleted sera, normal human serum, cobra venom factor and special reagents for all your complement research needs.
